title: Stamp the prototype with anchor-coded rotations
written_solution: Treat the largest non-anchor object as the exemplar. Each anchor color chooses how to transform that exemplar before stamping it with the anchor as the placement origin: red(2) → identity, green(3) → 90° clockwise, yellow(4) → 180°, gray(5) → 90° counter-clockwise.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (anti-transpose-grid grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid))) (define (apply-transform-name name grid) (cond ((equal? name 'id) grid) ((equal? name 'rot90) (rotate-cw grid)) ((equal? name 'rot180) (rotate-180 grid)) ((equal? name 'rot270) (rotate-ccw grid)) ((equal? name 'flip-h) (flip-lr grid)) ((equal? name 'flip-v) (flip-ud grid)) ((equal? name 'transpose) (transpose grid)) (else (anti-transpose-grid grid)))) (define (e8-cell<? a b) (or (< (first a) (first b)) (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b))))) (define (e8-norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) e8-cell<?)) (define (e8-cells->grid cells) (let* ((norm (e8-norm cells)) (bb (bbox-of-cells norm))) (if (not bb) (list (list 0)) (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb)) 0) norm 1)))) (define (e8-grid-shape grid) (e8-norm (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))) (grid-positions grid)))) (define (e8-transform-cells cells name) (e8-grid-shape (apply-transform-name name (e8-cells->grid cells)))) (let* ((anchors (filter (lambda (p) (member? (at g (first p) (second p)) (list 2 3 4 5))) (grid-positions g))) (proto (first (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (not (member? (obj-color obj) (list 2 3 4 5)))) (objects g 0)) (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))) (shape (e8-norm (obj-cells proto))) (color (obj-color proto))) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((anchor (in-list anchors))) (let* ((code (at g (first anchor) (second anchor))) (name (cond ((= code 2) 'id) ((= code 3) 'rot90) ((= code 4) 'rot180) (else 'rot270))) (tshape (e8-transform-cells shape name))) (paint-cells out (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first anchor) (first p)) (+ (second anchor) (second p)))) tshape) color))))))
